instruction: Fix `clamp` so it returns the lower bound when the value is below the range and the upper bound when it is above (the two returns are currently swapped).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats.py b/numstats.py
--- a/numstats.py
+++ b/numstats.py
@@ -39,9 +39,9 @@
 def clamp(value, lo, hi):
     """Clamp ``value`` to the inclusive range [lo, hi]."""
     if value < lo:
+        return lo
+    if value > hi:
         return hi
-    if value > hi:
-        return lo
     return value
